alternative_explanations_tested.aged_wallet_bought_or_reused_by_farm: CONFIRMED for h1 batch and dc49: aged (nonce 12-2078) NFT-mint wallets chained by funding 0.2-1.4 min before deposit; sybilkit's FIRST-funder peel rule misses them
alternative_explanations_tested.exchange_funded_set_is_one_operator: cannot distinguish for the scattered 0.051/0.055 aged wallets; several funded 1-4 min pre-deposit by exchange-scale wallets with 0.051-0.06 ETH; equally consistent with a human top-up
alternative_explanations_tested.0.051_is_a_farm_signature_not_human: false as a blanket statement: band is ENS-enriched 2.3x and 57% nonce>=20; true for 40 Disperse bots + h1 batch + dc49 (~83 of 195)

strongest_supported_claim: c7 is a heterogeneous weld: 42 audited 0.05 members + 40 provable Disperse 0.051 bots + >=43 aged-wallet peel groups (h1 0.051 batch, dc49 four-amount group) + ~255 honest-looking odd-amount wallets + the h34-35 0.05 rush, joined only because 'identical odd' 0.051/0.052/0.055 amounts reach across all hours and 0.05 index runs chain the rush. A near-min band exemption from exact-odd releases 429 (255 honest-looking, 58 nonce-0, 55 peel-funded incl. dc49 18 + p7 7) and leaves 569 flagged incl. all 40 Disperse bots and both cited ENS examples. Net honest FP attributable to exact-odd reach in c7 ~200-255, not 600.
recommended_fix_shape: band exemption (A) or 4-sig-digit rule (B) PLUS a 'funded by another member <=10 min before deposit' tier-A peel rule (would retain h1 batch and dc49 while releasing the exchange/self-funded aged wallets); block-span cap D alone releases too little (124) to fix the weld
